title: aquilegia vulgaris subsp. nevadensis
intro: Aquilegia vulgaris subsp. nevadensis, commonly known as Nevada Columbine, is a subspecies of the Aquilegia vulgaris plant, belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. This flowering plant is known for its delicate, bell-shaped flowers and is native to the mountainous regions of Nevada. The health benefits of Aquilegia vulgaris subsp. nevadensis include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of promoting relaxation and reducing anxiety.
